response.justification: While Szabo demonstrates strong software engineering credentials with 16+ years of experience and a clear senior IC trajectory, his background is fundamentally in application and infrastructure software rather than hardware architecture. The role requires specialized expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and AI accelerator optimization—areas with no evident experience in his resume. His current AI work involves agent infrastructure tooling rather than hardware-level performance optimization for AI workloads. The domain gap is too significant for this principal-level hardware architecture position.
strengths: Senior IC trajectory with multiple Staff Engineer roles and 16+ years of experience demonstrating sustained technical depth and leadership
Proven expertise in performance optimization and low-level systems programming (C, C++, DLang) with real-time and high-throughput constraints
Demonstrated full-stack architectural thinking across infrastructure, backend, and systems layers with DevOps expertise
concerns: No evidence of SoC or IP modeling experience, which is a core technical requirement and responsibility of the role
Background is centered on application and infrastructure software rather than hardware architecture, GPU design, or AI accelerator optimization
No demonstrated expertise in deep learning workload optimization, hardware-software co-design, or AI accelerator performance analysis
